scope: Repository-relative crate sources and fixtures, manifests, canonical scripts, book Rust examples and build controls, including every filename in the coverage reports. Dependencies are identified by Cargo.lock.
provenance: The listed files match the Git blobs at the measured revision. LLVM reports identify source filenames. The manifest records the checked contents of those files and additional build inputs.
digest_format: SHA-256 of path-sorted UTF-8 lines: lowercase sha256, two spaces, repository-relative path, newline.
